This repository uses one long-lived Feedback pull request for the whole
module, opened automatically when you accept the assignment. Its base never
moves, so it always shows the full diff from your starting point to your
latest work — this text is its starting body, not something you fill in once
per stage.

**At each milestone (`f1`, `f2`, `summative`), post a comment on this PR**
using the template below, right after you push that milestone's tag. That
gives your facilitator one comment per stage to review against, in the same
PR that already shows the cumulative diff.

---

## Milestone comment template

Copy this into a new comment on this PR each time you push a milestone tag.

### Milestone

- [ ] F1 — tag `f1` pushed
- [ ] F2 — tag `f2` pushed
- [ ] Summative — tag `summative` pushed

### Summary of Changes

Describe the main work completed for this stage.

### Evidence and Tests Run

List the checks, tests, or manual evidence you used.

### Trade-off or Known Limitation

State one important compromise, limitation, or deferred improvement.

### AI Use Disclosure

If you used AI support, describe:

- what tool you used
- what you asked it to help with
- what you changed before accepting the output
